cohort: 200 first-trimester pregnant women attending the antenatal clinic of a tertiary care facility in Andhra Pradesh, India.
finding: Subclinical hypothyroidism was the most common thyroid disorder (10%), followed by overt hypothyroidism (6%), subclinical hyperthyroidism (3%), and no cases of overt hyperthyroidism were found, with overall thyroid dysfunction affecting 19% of the participants.
